content.title: Chuck Norris Mourns Ex-Wife and High School Sweetheart Dianne Holechek After Her Death at 84: 'Meant the World to Me'
content.text: Chuck Norris and Dianne Holechek on Jan. 24, 1986. Credit : Ron Galella/Ron Galella Collection via Getty NEED TO KNOW Dianne Holechek, who was married to ex-husband Chuck Norris for 30 years, died at 84Norris announced Holechek's death on Facebook on Sunday, Dec. 21The former couple share adult sons Mike and Eric; Chuck also shares twins Dakota and Danilee with wife Gena O'Kelly, whom he married in 1998 Diane Holechek, the ex-wife of Chuck Norris, has died at age 84. Norris, 85, announced Holechek's death in a Facebook post shared Sunday, Dec. 21. The action star shared a black-and-white photo of the former couple posing together with their sons Mike Norris, now 63, and Eric Norris, now 60. "I am deeply saddened to share that my ex wife, Dianne, has passed away. After being married for 30 years, we were able to find a way to remain close friends, and those years of friendship meant the world to me," Chuck wrote in his Facebook post. "Dianne was an incredible person. She was kind, intelligent, and lived life to the fullest. Her presence in my life will never be forgotten. She was also a loving and devoted mother to our sons, Mike and Eric, who were always her greatest pride." Norris and Holecek met as high school students in Torrance, Calif., and married when they were still teenagers in 1958, according to multiple outlets. Their older son Mike followed in Chuck's footsteps as an actor and stunt performer in Hollywood, while their younger son Eric dabbled in professional racing with NASCAR before settling into his own role as a stunt coordinator and driver in Holywood. Chuck Norris and Dianne Holechek on Dec. 4, 1986. Holechek and Norris separated in 1988 and finalized their divorce in 1989, multiple outlets reported. "Even as our lives took different directions, we continued to care deeply for one another, and I will forever cherish the memories we built together," Chuck wrote in his Facebook post Dec. 21. TMZ was first to report news of Holechek's death on Dec. 21. Their son Mike told the outlet she died peacefully at her home in Texas after a lengthy bout with dementia. Related Stories Chuck Norris and Dianne Holechek in 1978. Nik Wheeler/Corbis via Getty "We are thankful she is no longer suffering. She was the best, the greatest mom. We were so lucky to have her," Mike told the outlet. Chuck, who last made a movie with 2024's Agent Recon, married wife Gena O'Kelly in 1998, and the pair welcomed twins Dakota and Danilee in 2001. Chuck also has a daughter named Dina, whom he did not know until she reached out to him in 1991 and claimed to be his daughter from an affair he had while married to Holecheck, per a Unilad article that attributed the actor's 2004 book Against All Odds: My Story.
